lcb-001.problem: There are three cards with letters a, b, c placed in a row in some order. You can do the following operation at most once: Pick two cards, and swap them. Is it possible that the row becomes abc after the operation? Output "YES" if it is possible, and "NO" otherwise.

lcb-002.problem: Slavic has an array a of n digits and the present will be the product of all these digits. Slavic wants to add 1 to exactly one of his digits. What is the maximum product Slavic can make?

lcb-003.problem: You are given a strip of paper s that is n cells long. Each cell is either black or white. In an operation you can take any k consecutive cells and make them all white. Find the minimum number of operations needed to remove all black cells.

lcb-004.problem: Check if it is possible to remove exactly k characters from the string s of length n in such a way that the remaining characters can be rearranged to form a palindrome.

lcb-005.problem: Find the minimum number of operations (+1 to an element) needed to make the product of all the numbers in the array divisible by k (where 2 <= k <= 5).

lcb-006.problem: Given an integer n. Vanya can add 1 or subtract 1. If after Vanya's move the integer is divisible by 3, he wins ("First"). Otherwise Vova wins ("Second"). Both play optimally.

lcb-007.problem: Divide n boxes into trucks of equal size k boxes each. Maximize the absolute difference between the total weights of any two trucks.

lcb-008.problem: Find the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray such that adjacent elements have alternating parities.

lcb-009.problem: Given note exponents a_i where b_i = 2^(a_i). Count pairs (i, j) with i < j such that b_i^(b_j) == b_j^(b_i).

lcb-010.problem: Given passenger detail strings of length 15 where characters 11-12 denote age. Return the count of passengers strictly more than 60 years old.

lcb-011.problem: Repeatedly remove the maximum value from each row of a matrix and add the maximum of those removed values to the score until the matrix is empty.

lcb-012.problem: Multiply elements by 2 up to k times total to maximize the bitwise OR sum of the array.

lcb-013.problem: Find the maximum product of a non-empty subset of the given array of student scores.

lcb-014.problem: Break up string s into non-overlapping dictionary words minimizing the count of remaining unused extra characters.

lcb-015.problem: Buy exactly two chocolates from the prices array to minimize total cost. Return leftover money if total cost <= money, else return money.

lcb-016.problem: Count integers x between numeric strings num1 and num2 inclusive whose digit sum satisfies min_sum <= digit_sum(x) <= max_sum, modulo 10^9 + 7.

lcb-017.problem: Return an array diff where diff[i] is the number of distinct elements in prefix nums[0...i] minus distinct elements in suffix nums[i+1...n-1].

lcb-018.problem: Process an array of queries coloring index_i with color_i. Return an array tracking the number of adjacent matching non-zero colored elements after each step.

lcb-019.problem: Find the sum of power of all non-empty subsets of heroes where power is max(subset)^2 * min(subset), modulo 10^9 + 7.

lcb-020.problem: Find the minimum adjacent swaps to move the value 1 to the front and the value n to the end of a permutation array.

lcb-021.problem: Find the length of the longest substring containing at most one adjacent identical pair of digits.

lcb-022.problem: Friends play a circular passing game where turn i moves i*k steps. Game ends when a player gets the ball twice. Return a sorted list of unvisited losers.

lcb-023.problem: Determine if there is a binary original array that matches the neighboring bitwise XOR cyclic sequence derived.

lcb-024.problem: Find the minimum possible length of string s after repeatedly removing any occurrences of substrings 'AB' or 'CD'.

lcb-025.problem: Return the sum of squares of all integers i (1 <= i <= n) whose square's decimal string can be split into substrings adding up to i.

lcb-026.problem: Find the minimum cost to paint n walls using a paid painter taking cost[i] money and time[i] time, and a free painter taking 1 unit of time whenever the paid painter is busy.

lcb-027.problem: Find the minimum total cost to collect all types of chocolates where an operation cyclically shifts available choices at price x.

lcb-028.problem: Find the minimum possible sum of an array of length n consisting of distinct positive integers such that no two elements add up to k.

lcb-029.problem: Find the maximum achievable integer x that can become equal to num after at most t increments/decrements applied simultaneously to both x and num.

lcb-030.problem: Make a string a palindrome with the minimum changes, picking the lexicographically smallest outcome on a tie.

lcb-031.problem: Find the minimum cost to make all binary characters equal by flipping prefixes 0...i (cost i+1) or suffixes i...n-1 (cost n-i).

lcb-032.problem: Remove all trailing zeros from a positive integer string string representation.

lcb-033.problem: Check if a 3-digit number n is fascinating. The combination of n, 2*n, and 3*n must contain all digits 1-9 exactly once without any zeros.

lcb-034.problem: Minimize string length by selecting index i and deleting its closest duplicate matching characters to its immediate left and right.

lcb-035.problem: Determine if all indices are transitively connected in a sequence where hops require gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) > 1.

lcb-036.problem: Transform exactly one non-empty substring by decrementing each letter ('a' becomes 'z') to obtain the lexicographically smallest result.

lcb-037.problem: Count pairs (i, j) with i < j such that the first digit of nums[i] and the last digit of nums[j] are coprime.

lcb-038.problem: Find the length of the longest possible equal subarray after deleting at most k elements.

lcb-039.problem: Count how many of n servers received zero requests within individual query windows [query - x, query].

lcb-040.problem: Track positions of marbles over movement steps from moveFrom to moveTo. Return a sorted list of occupied unique positions.

student-001.problem: takes a list of strings, integers, and floats and returns the sum of all the integers and floats.

custom-001.problem: Write function to calculate GST. Input: price, rate (5/12/18/28). Output: {subtotal, gst, total}. Handle: negative price raises error, proper rounding to 2 decimal places.

custom-002.problem: Validate identity number (12 digits). Check: format, not all zeros, Verhoeff algorithm for check digit. Return: {valid: bool, normalized: str, errors: list}.

custom-003.problem: Validate Indian PAN format (AAAAA9999A). Return validation result with detailed error message if invalid.

custom-004.problem: Validate Indian mobile number (10 digits, starts with 6-9). Handle +91 prefix. Return standardized format or error.

custom-005.problem: Validate Indian pincode (exactly 6 digits, no special characters). Return {valid: bool, error: str}.

student-manual-002.problem: count how many words are in the string

student-manual-003.problem: find all duplicate numbers in a list

student-manual-004.problem: check if a list is sorted

medium-001.problem: check if a number is prime

medium-002.problem: find the second largest number in a list

medium-004.problem: count occurrences of each character in a string
